title: Emergency Phrases: English <-> Romanian
summary: Essential bilingual English-Romanian communication phrases for medical, rescue, and utility emergencies.
content:
Show this card directly on screen and point to the relevant phrase if you or the person you are assisting do not speak the same language.

1. EN: Help! / I need help immediately. | RO: Ajutor! / Am nevoie de ajutor imediat.
2. EN: Please call an ambulance / police on 999 or 112. | RO: Vă rog să chemați o ambulanță / poliția la 999 sau 112.
3. EN: I am hurt / injured / bleeding. | RO: Sunt rănit(ă) / sângerez.
4. EN: I have a medical condition (diabetic / heart condition). | RO: Am o afecțiune medicală (sunt diabetic(ă) / am probleme cu inima).
5. EN: Where is the nearest hospital or emergency room? | RO: Unde este cel mai apropiat spital sau serviciu de urgență?
6. EN: I need drinking water and food. | RO: Am nevoie de apă de băut și mâncare.
7. EN: The power is out / There is no electricity. | RO: S-a oprit curentul / Nu este electricitate.
8. EN: Is this tap water safe to drink? | RO: Este sigură apa de la robinet pentru băut?
9. EN: I need my prescription medication urgently. | RO: Am nevoie urgentă de medicamentele mele prescrise.
10. EN: Do you speak English? / I do not speak English well. | RO: Vorbiți engleză? / Nu vorbesc bine limba engleză.
11. EN: Where is the safe shelter or evacuation point? | RO: Unde este adăpostul sigur sau punctul de evacuare?

Closing tip: Point with your finger directly at the sentence you need. Speak slowly in short, calm words, use hand gestures to clarify meaning, and write numbers or names down on paper if necessary.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
